scope: Static review of current bounded preflight and future gated formal runners, focused on authorization, budgets, calibration, forks, patch provenance, preservation and verification.

checks.evidence: experiment.authorize and execution.validate_formal_authorization reject missing/wrong stage, freeze and role evidence; current preflight authorization cannot grant formal stages.
Per-worker fixed timing manifest and counters bound generation/branch, candidate, donor and calibration work; confirmation items receive tokenizer checks only.
Per-GPU nonblocking project lock plus live compute-process rejection precede loading; launcher only terminates its own child workers on failure; outputs/execution/evidence use exclusive creation.
Fact pairs share fact0 reference; explicit reference hash is separate from current input identity; native and common-direction writes have separate mask, dose and actual write audits.

Same generated history, pre-forward cache fingerprints, exact continue replay and total prefix-inclusive budget are enforced; EOS branches are NA; preflight cannot pass without exercising both k4 and k16.
Only transient fork logits are retained in memory; all three actual next tokens form a common union with per-arm logit/logprob artifacts bound to hashes.

Donor site/step, tensor hash, generated prefix and calibration hash are checked; diagnostic patch items remain fact-paired; patch sources require current formal full records while historical anchors use an explicit mechanism-only adapter.

Selection evidence, source item/condition identity, measurement attestations, pre-confirmation interpretation/selection locks and historical first-opening gate are bound; confirmation followups retain original selection and bind separate source manifests.

Formal plan is recomputed and exact record set checked; output token hashes, execution identity, item identity, reference, branch applicability, continue/state comparisons and branch-comparison assets are verified.
Full-forward technical checks are separately counted; formal costs include calibration, candidates, source replay, branch prefix replay and per-arm donors; no formal automatic launcher exists.

resolved_findings.finding: Preflight did not verify CPU/data/code evidence before model load.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit four-role hash/status/source validation, zero-skip CPU result and current data hashes added.

resolved_findings.finding: Formal stages lacked concrete selection and measurement gates.
resolved_findings.resolution: Stage gates, source identities, paired selection and frozen confirmation followups added.

resolved_findings.finding: Patch donors were not bound to generated history and shared calibration.
resolved_findings.resolution: Runtime site, history, reference and tensor hash checks plus rejection tests added.

resolved_findings.finding: Unreachable k4/k16 paths could leave technical preflight passed without testing forks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both real fork checks are mandatory for preflight completion; scientific NA remains preserved in formal runs.

resolved_findings.finding: Cross-branch actual competitor logits could be absent outside top32.
resolved_findings.resolution: Transient fork logits yield a shared actual-token-union readout without storing full logits by default.

resolved_findings.finding: Patch candidates could include only one diagnostic fact or a legacy source unsupported by patch execution.
resolved_findings.resolution: Paired facts enforced and current formal source schema required for patch candidates.

resolved_findings.finding: Worker verification initially trusted listed hashes without exact expected coverage or token verification.
resolved_findings.resolution: Execution identity, token and plan/record-set verification now explicit.

resolved_findings.finding: Confirmation semantic-lock test originally checked only an earlier bad-review failure.
resolved_findings.resolution: False interpretation/selection/unseen flags are now tested with correctly rebound evidence hashes.

limitations: This status covers static implementation review only; separate successful CPU and real GPU receipts are still required.
No formal selection, measurement-validity decision, causal result or actual ETA is certified by this review.
ETA calculation code is outside this focused review; root integration must verify its arithmetic and observed timing inputs.
Any change to a bound file requires a new review version; preserve this receipt unchanged.
